label: Alpine Heatmap
description: Alpine heatmap — friendly mobile-marketing card: a rows×cols grid of rounded cells colored on a single-hue intensity scale, with row/column labels and a Less→More legend. v2 rebuilds the geometry as a RATIO layout (clean grid() cells; gaps applied as lattice-retargeted source insets, exact at every canvas), so it composes anywhere without the coprime-pixel precision blowup. Generalizes the GitHub contribution calendar.

rows.label: Rows
rows.description: Matrix rows. Each: an optional label + its cell values (left→right; number[] or a comma list).

colLabels.label: Column Labels
colLabels.description: Column headers along the top (index-aligned to columns).

color.label: Scale color
color.description: Full-intensity hue of the scale. Defaults to the theme primary.

showValues.label: Show values
showValues.description: Print each cell's value inside it.

scale.label: Scale
scale.description: Scale bounds + cell fine-tuning (auto-fits when unset).

anim.renderMode.label: Render mode
anim.renderMode.description: "premium" (default): diagonal alpha-fade cascade — the softest look, but one per-pixel geq PER CELL, paid every frame of a nesting parent's whole timeline (the pack's heaviest geq load). "light": the same cascade via free enable-gate pops — no geq, composable, cheap when nested.

anim.reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
anim.reduceMotion.description: Skip motion; render the final static card.

anim.introFrac.label: Intro length
anim.introFrac.description: Share of the clip the intro fills (the rest holds).

theme.slug.label: Producer slug
theme.slug.description: Producer template to seed tokens from (e.g. "@m0saic/theming/v1").

theme.namespace.label: Namespace
theme.namespace.description: Upstream alias to read tokens from. Default "theme".

theme.forceFetch.label: Force fetch
theme.forceFetch.description: Re-seed via the slug even if the namespace is populated.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Opt into a theme source. Uses the alpine preset by default; set a producer slug + namespace to pull shared design tokens. Explicit color props still win.

debugLayout.label: Debug layout
debugLayout.description: Dev-only layout contract view: renders the contract wireframe instead of the board — cells GREEN with the measured rule when all equal-size, offenders RED when not. Deterministic false default; production never sets it.
